name: Contour Card
description: A card drawn over a living contour map: a low hill follows the pointer, the lines flow around it, and a small label reads the elevation underneath.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks the terrain. The same seed gives the same map.

props.name: interval
props.description: Elevation between neighbouring lines. Every fifth line is an index line, drawn heavier.

props.name: range
props.description: Lowest and highest elevation on the map, in metres. Sets the numbers in the label and, with interval, how many lines there are.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Colour of the ordinary contour lines.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Raise a low hill under the pointer, let the map drift with it, and show the elevation label. Off, the map only drifts slowly.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, which is rounded, bordered and padded by default. The map fades out towards the top and bottom edges so text placed there reads. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: The card's content, drawn above the map.
